newsitem.title: USA: Newmont focus is on Santa Fe, not Busang.
newsitem.headline: Newmont focus is on Santa Fe, not Busang.

text.p: Indonesia's Busang gold find might present an opportunity for Newmont Mining Corp in the future, but its focus now is on its bid for Santa Fe Pacific Gold Corp, a Newmont spokesman said on Thursday.
"It's (Busang) an interesting property. If an opportunity arose we would want to take a look at it, but we're pretty focused on Santa Fe right now," said Newmont spokesman Doug Hock.
Speculation has circulated that Newmont and Canadian gold producer Teck Corp may be keen on bidding for the Indonesian property.

Currently, the Indonesian government is awaiting the outcome of negotiations between two Canadian companies, Bre-X Minerals Ltd and Barrick Gold Corp, with their local partners ahead of a mid-February deadline set by the government.
The Newmont spokesman said he had no comment on remarks by Teck senior vice president Mike Lipkewich that Newmont and Teck were discussing a joint bid.

Hock said Newmont and Teck did discuss the Busang property last year, before Newmont bid for Santa Fe. Hock said Newmont was having conversations with Santa Fe and Newmont hopes to meet with Santa Fe executives in the near future, although no date has been set. Santa Fe has important gold holdings in the state of Nevada, which are near Newmont's Carlin trend property.
Hock said Newmont Chief Financial Officer Wayne Murdy was in Jakarta last week but no other senior Newmont executives were in Jakarta now.
Newmont's attention in Indonesia is now focused on its Batu Hijau property, Hock said.
